flyer.justification: The flyer captures the core message and logistics well, but the title exceeds the strict 6-word limit.

summary.justification: The executive briefing accurately summarizes the core concepts, includes actionable framing, and meets all formatting and length rules.

linkedin.justification: The post is well-written and avoids banned cliches, but it completely omits the required 3-5 hashtags.

instagram.justification: The caption effectively integrates visual carousel cues, emoji styling, a call to action, and exactly 10 targeted hashtags.

newsletter.justification: The newsletter follows all structure and style requirements, including a subject line under 50 characters and three distinct bold subheadings.

blog.justification: The blog post adheres perfectly to markdown formatting, includes numbered insights, a comparison table, and an accurate About the Author section.
